name: memory_selector_fail_closed_v1
scope: Versioned engineering failure-accounting protocol; strict native_v1 remains failed and immutable
trigger: Only exhausted Memory Selector schema ValueError after existing configured two attempts
result: Whole sample is failed: empty answer, format-invalid, score zero. No final answering with an empty selection; invalid role is never accepted or mapped. Training failure may enter ordinary adaptation experience as an observed failure.
prefix_reuse: Latest committed checkpoint of each schema-failed arm, selected by chronology not performance; original completed stages and calls retained and counted. Successful original arms can be reused because they never exercised the exception path; no output is selected by score.
preserve: Original failure traceback, logs, uncommitted-memory quarantine and original metrics remain separate. Final report must show strict run failure and recovery protocol separately.
stop: One recovery dispatch per eligible arm only; unrelated errors remain fatal. No parameter search or further recovery protocols.
